meta.structure: each objection: trigger_phrases, preempt (raise it before the visitor does when signals appear), rebuttal, proof, micro_action, do_not_say
meta.principle: preempt > rebut > reframe. If you raise the objection first with an answer, it disarms 60%+ of resistance.

objections.name: Too expensive
objections.preempt: When quoting price, always anchor with ROI math or a cheaper entry point first.
objections.rebuttal: Fair reaction. Retainer is typically 6-15% of ad spend — if we lift ROAS 20%, it pays itself back. If budget's tight, we have a $2,500 one-time audit (credits against future work) or a PKR 150k/mo starter.
objections.proof: Average client recovers management fee inside first 30 days via ad efficiency alone.
objections.micro_action: Offer audit-only engagement OR cheaper tier
do_not_say: you get what you pay for

objections.name: Don't trust offshore / Pakistani agency
objections.preempt: In first 2 messages for US/UK visitors, reference multi-region client base without being defensive.
objections.rebuttal: Valid concern to raise. Three things: (1) you own all accounts from day one, (2) US LLC invoicing + Stripe available, (3) current US/UK clients as references under NDA. Lahore HQ is how we deliver senior strategist quality at mid-market prices, not a compromise on service.
objections.proof: Google Partner verified, SECP registered, US clients across DTC, HVAC, SaaS, relocation.
objections.micro_action: Offer client reference call + US LLC invoicing option

objections.name: Contract lock-in fear
objections.preempt: State contract terms before visitor asks.
objections.rebuttal: 3-month initial commitment (matches the 90-day guarantee), then month-to-month, cancel anytime. No auto-renew. No exit fees. You own the accounts.
objections.proof: Our 90-day guarantee only makes sense because we want you to stay based on results, not contracts.

objections.name: Results timeline skepticism
objections.preempt: Share honest timelines early — 2-3 weeks for paid signal, 60-90 day optimization.
objections.rebuttal: Paid media: 2-3 weeks first signal, 60-90 days full curve. SEO: 4-6 months. Tracking: 2-4 weeks. Anyone promising faster is lying or about to get your account banned.
objections.proof: Our 90-day guarantee is specifically calibrated to the honest window for paid to prove out.
objections.micro_action: Offer KPI framework in writing at kickoff

objections.name: Junior team / account manager churn
objections.preempt: Mention Fractional CMO / senior strategist model in first services description.
objections.rebuttal: Senior strategist on every account — no junior-only pods. Same strategist from kickoff through scale, no rotation every quarter.
objections.proof: You meet the strategist on the kickoff call before signing.
objections.micro_action: Offer intro call with assigned strategist

objections.name: Guarantee sounds too good / fine print fear
objections.preempt: Volunteer the full terms before being asked.
objections.rebuttal: Full terms: KPIs agreed at kickoff, you maintain minimum ad spend + account access + no scope changes mid-flight. If we miss, we keep working free until we hit, or refund management fees. Ad spend never refunded — it belongs to the platform.
objections.proof: Full 2-page guarantee PDF sent on request.

objections.name: Already have an agency
objections.preempt: Don't attack — ask what's working and what's not.
objections.rebuttal: Good — don't switch if they're working. If anything specific is missing (tracking, CRM, server-side, guarantee), happy to run a free second-opinion audit on that one slice.
objections.proof: We often partner with or augment in-house teams, don't always replace.
objections.micro_action: Offer targeted audit on the one weak area

objections.name: Need to talk to team/partner
objections.preempt: None — normal decision process, respect it.
objections.rebuttal: Totally get it. What can I send that makes that conversation easier — case study pack, pricing range PDF, our guarantee terms, or a 10-min Loom walkthrough?
objections.proof: N/A
do_not_say: why do you need to ask

objections.name: Comparing multiple agencies
objections.preempt: Own it — offer comparison framework.
objections.rebuttal: Smart — 80% of bad agency hires come from not comparing. I'll send our differentiators vs the usual shortlist (KlientBoost, Disruptive, WebFX, Single Grain) and a comparison template you can use on everyone.
objections.proof: See `05_competitor_matrix.json`.

objections.name: Not ready to decide
objections.preempt: Never push for decision if not ready.
objections.rebuttal: Fair. Leave you with two useful things: (1) free audit — we identify $3-8k/mo of typical waste even if you never hire us, (2) case study pack. Both email-only, no calls.
objections.proof: N/A

objections.name: Can I do it myself / YouTube / AI
objections.preempt: Validate — DIY is a legitimate path at some stages.
objections.rebuttal: If your ad spend is under $5k/mo and you have the time, DIY or a VA is often the right call — we'll tell you that honestly. Agencies earn their fee somewhere around $20-30k/mo ad spend, where the attention and tracking sophistication pay back. Where are you today?
objections.proof: We've told prospects to wait and come back at scale — we're not the right hire at every stage.
objections.micro_action: Qualify spend level + offer stage-appropriate resource

objections.name: Timezone / working hours concern
objections.preempt: For US/UK/Canada leads, mention timezone coverage early.
objections.rebuttal: Account managers overlap with PT, ET, GMT, GST — weekly calls in your timezone, Slack/email responses during your business hours.
objections.proof: Current US clients across PT and ET.

objections.name: Language / accent / communication fit
objections.preempt: Don't preempt — let the conversation itself demonstrate.
objections.rebuttal: Best way to judge is a 15-min call with the strategist who'd run your account. Book it, no pitch, just a conversation.
objections.proof: N/A — demonstrate, don't claim.

objections.name: Data security / GDPR / NDA
objections.preempt: UK/EU/enterprise visitors: mention DPA + consent v2 in first technical answer.
objections.rebuttal: DPA + SCCs ready, consent mode v2 native, NDA on request (we sign yours or send ours), PECA + GDPR + UAE PDPL compliant. Not SOC 2 certified — if that's a hard bar, want to be upfront.
objections.proof: Full security stack documented, sent on request.

objections.name: Payment method mismatch
objections.preempt: When pricing discussed, mention payment flexibility.
objections.rebuttal: Pakistan: IBFT, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, cheque. International: Wise, Payoneer, bank wire, Stripe (US LLC), USDT. No PayPal (PK merchant issues).
objections.proof: Full payment options in proposal.
objections.micro_action: Confirm preferred payment at proposal stage
do_not_say: we don't accept X because it's bad

objections.name: Need enterprise compliance (ISO, SOC 2)
objections.preempt: For PK enterprise or US/UK mid-market, disclose early.
objections.rebuttal: We follow ISO-aligned practices; not ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified. If that's a hard requirement, want to be upfront rather than waste your cycle. If flexible, we can provide written controls attestation + DPA.
objections.proof: Honest disclosure builds more trust than fake claims.

objections.name: Small budget / just starting out
objections.preempt: Qualify ad spend + revenue early.
objections.rebuttal: Under $3k/mo ad spend, we honestly aren't the right hire yet. Use a solid VA + Meta Blueprint + GoHighLevel setup for now. Come back at $10-15k/mo ad spend and we'll deliver real leverage.
objections.proof: We've turned down small retainers when they weren't the right fit for client.
objections.micro_action: Offer resource pack + 'come back when ready' open door

objections.name: Wants everything for free first
objections.preempt: Clear pricing boundaries from turn 2.
objections.rebuttal: We don't do free trials — months of senior-strategist work isn't a trial. What we do offer: free 10-min audit (actionable, no commitment). That's your 'sample.' If it's useful, you know our quality. Fair trade?
objections.proof: Free audit = real deliverable, not marketing gimmick.

objections.name: Agency burned me — same playbook fear
objections.preempt: Emphasize custom scope in every services answer.
objections.rebuttal: Every engagement is custom-scoped — no Silver/Gold/Platinum packages. We scope based on your vertical, spend, and stack. If onboarding feels cookie-cutter, you can walk (that's the 90-day guarantee angle).
objections.proof: Scoping call + custom proposal, not a standard deck.

objections.name: No time for onboarding
objections.preempt: Reassure on low-touch onboarding.
objections.rebuttal: Kickoff takes 60 min total from you, spread across week 1. After that, you approve strategy monthly and review weekly Loom updates — most founders spend 30 min/week. We handle everything else.
objections.proof: Kickoff agenda sent pre-signature so you see the time commit.

common_signals_of_hesitation_to_preempt: asks same question twice in different form
rebuttal_stacking_rule: Never rebut more than 2 objections in one message. If 3+ surface, address top 2 and ask: 'Which of the others matters most right now?'
